minor.comment: `launch({ args })` in `justdom-xr/driver` passes extra flags to Chromium, such as a Blink feature a check needs

none.comment: Scripts that call other scripts pass `--loglevel=warn` to `npm run`, so the notices npm 12 prints on stderr no longer fail `rush build` with warnings.

minor.comment: inputModels() takes an optional path to the app's own copy of the WebXR input profiles, so a headset can draw controllers and hands without the CDN

patch.comment: The driver imports playwright-core as an optional peer dependency, so it runs outside the justdom repository

none.comment: Comments call justdom-three by its name instead of freedom
Docs and the emulator driver name the castle, showcase and todo demos by their new folder names
Renamed from `@apendua.dev/headset`, and moved from apendua.dev to the justdom repository
Load the controller and hand models from three's default CDN; inputModels() takes no base

patch.comment: The README is a short overview that links to the guide and the API reference on justdom.dev, which now hold what it used to say; its stale claims about peer dependencies and old package names are fixed
